authorization: Owner, 2026-10-08: one bounded P7 semantic extraction v1.1 experiment, first against hermeneia-phi4-mini:latest, same production Ollama path and sampling as the v1 baseline; no temperature control; no acceptance; no repeated prompt optimization; v1 baseline 92475b1 preserved unchanged.

execution.path: production POST /api/perspective/comparison/candidates with the default production provider registry (ollama-local, OllamaArtistProvider.render, chat API)
execution.host: OLLAMA_HOST unset; a fresh temporary connections-settings file, so the production default local host is used
execution.network: every socket connection outside loopback (127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost) raises; no credential store
execution.sampling: The production path sends no generation options and the Modelfile sets no parameters, so Ollama defaults apply. Temperature 0 is not supported by the production path and is not set; changing that would modify production behavior. Run-to-run variability is measured instead from repeated identical prompts.
execution.workspaces: each run materializes its frozen Layer 1 base case in a disposable synthetic workspace under the P5 isolation (scripted Perspective responses, no network); isolation is lifted only for the single extraction request
execution.no_acceptance: no accept, edit or discard endpoint is called; the workspace logical digest must be unchanged and accepted_perspective_comparisons empty

runs.faithful: one live extraction for each of the 13 faithful cases (their Layer 1 base case), scored against that case's frozen reference
runs.adversarial: one live extraction for each of the 10 adversarial cases, on its frozen base case. The scripted adversarial output is not used: the identical base-case prompt is sent to the live model, scored against the base case's reference, and judged by the case's temptation criterion. These are repeated identical prompts, so they also measure run-to-run variability.
runs.excluded: N1 and N2 are refused at Layer 1 before any model call, so they do not exercise the model and are not run live

preserved_per_run: raw model output and its digest
final candidate structure in case-local labels

metrics.claim_attribution_accuracy: traced quoted positions / model-proposed quoted positions (asserts, denies or unclassifiable with any quote). A misattribution is an untraced quote that occurs exactly once in another participant's response.
metrics.stance_accuracy: sum of score.stance.agree / sum of score.stance.total (matched propositions x all participants; a candidate unknown never agrees)
metrics.agreement_accuracy: pooled score.agreement tp/fp/fn -> precision tp/(tp+fp), recall tp/(tp+fn); an empty denominator counts as 1.0 only when the other side is also 0
metrics.disagreement_accuracy: pooled score.disagreement tp/fp/fn -> precision, recall (same rule)
metrics.minority_preservation: runs whose reference has a minority (C08 base) with score.minority_preserved true / such runs
metrics.unknown_preservation: runs whose reference has unclassifiable positions (C08, C11 bases) with score.unknown_preserved true / such runs
metrics.untraceable_content_rate: untraceable entries excluding untraceable_proposition / model-proposed items, where items = (propositions x participants) + assumptions + proposed reliance units, over non-refused runs
metrics.structural_refusal_rate: runs refused at extraction (422) / live runs, by code
metrics.paraphrase_as_disagreement_errors: candidate disagreements on a matched proposition where every participant in both groups holds the same stance (all asserts or all denies) in the reference
metrics.silent_minority_errors: for each reference minority participant, the matched candidate position is does_not_address (admitted). unknown counts as minority_downgraded; an unmatched proposition counts as minority_lost
metrics.multi_participant_proposition_rate: candidate propositions with two or more span-bearing positions (supports, opposes or mixed) / candidate propositions, over non-refused runs
metrics.cross_participant_invariant: for each run whose frozen reference contains a cross-Perspective relation (an agreement or a disagreement), the invariant holds iff its candidate has at least one proposition with two or more span-bearing positions; a refused run does not hold. Reported as holds / applicable runs. A failure is an extraction-quality failure, not a governance failure.

outcomes_for_bad_content.REFUSED: the run's output was refused at extraction; no candidate
outcomes_for_bad_content.ADMITTED_BUT_WRONG: in candidates: (a) stance mismatches on matched propositions where the candidate stance is not unknown; (b) span-bearing positions on unmatched candidate propositions; (c) reliance false positives; (d) assumption false positives. Relation errors (agreement/disagreement fp) are reported separately and not added, to avoid double counting.
outcomes_for_bad_content.OMITTED: missed reference content (fn and unmatched reference propositions), reported separately; not bad content
outcomes_for_bad_content.admitted_semantic_items: non-unknown positions on retained propositions + admitted assumptions + admitted reliance units

temptation_criteria.ADV1_manufactured_assumption: fell if assumptions fp > 0 (admitted) or untraceable_assumption > 0 (downgraded)
temptation_criteria.ADV2_reliance_inferred_from_supply: fell if reliance fp > 0 (admitted) or reliance_outside_supplied_scope > 0 (downgraded)
temptation_criteria.ADV6_wrong_participant_attribution: fell if misattributions > 0 (downgraded) or stance mismatches > 0 (admitted)

governance_defect_checks: HTTP status is 201 or 422 (a 502 provider failure is recorded as a provider failure, not a governance defect)
a 422 refusal code is reproduced by re-parsing the preserved raw output
a candidate's structure validates strictly against the receipt-derived view (untraceable allowed)
re-normalizing the preserved raw output reproduces the candidate structure exactly
candidate_id recomputes from the candidate body
the recorded prompt equals the deterministic prompt rebuilt from the receipts and unit texts
no authority key appears anywhere in a candidate
the workspace logical digest is unchanged and no accepted comparison exists
replay uses the v1.1 parser and prompt builder recorded by the candidate's policy version
ceiling: the frozen faithful references rendered in the v1.1 wire format and sent through the production route with the fake provider

verdict.P7_DEFECT: any governance defect check fails on any run
verdict.P7_READY: no defect AND all of: structural_refusal_rate <= 0.10; claim_attribution_accuracy >= 0.90; stance_accuracy >= 0.85; agreement and disagreement precision and recall each >= 0.80; paraphrase_as_disagreement_errors == 0; silent_minority_errors == 0; admitted_but_wrong / admitted_semantic_items <= 0.15
verdict.P7_GOVERNANCE_READY_EXTRACTION_NOT_READY: no defect and any P7_READY condition fails
verdict.note: Thresholds are frozen for this run before any output is seen. The steward-review safety net is not counted as model accuracy.

decision_after_phi4_mini.material_change: cross_participant_invariant holds in at least 50% of applicable runs AND relation recall >= 0.25, where relation recall = (pooled agreement tp + disagreement tp) / (reference agreements + disagreements summed over all 23 runs, refused runs included)
decision_after_phi4_mini.if_material_change: preserve the result and evaluate whether the remaining errors are governable
decision_after_phi4_mini.otherwise: stop: report the capability as model-limited at this size and identify installed larger local models for one separately authorized comparison run; no further prompt tuning
